questions.explanation: 叔叔 is father's younger brother. The tempting wrong idea is to treat all paternal uncles as one term.

questions.learningObjective: Identify a diminutive suffix in a term

options.text: 桌子 (table) contains the 子 suffix
options.misconception: treats a noun suffix as diminutive

options.text: 孩子 (child) contains the 子 suffix

options.misconception: mistakes a noun suffix for diminutive

questions.learningObjective: Group words by a shared suffix
